decision: No improved globally stationary preparation demonstrated. Keep original104 for directly comparable resolution campaign. MIX trial remains explicitly experimental and is not promoted to a live model; fixed-halo exploratory controls may finish. Higher halo sampling is now allowed, subject to registered cost/accuracy pilots.
reason: Orbit-phase sampling does not consistently improve both populations across seeds and does not solve density/potential closure. Inherited original controls show small thin height drift but nonzero velocity-moment changes; all-population equilibrium is unproven. A full orbit-weight fit or a more accurate action/potential method would require a separate validated preparation, not arbitrary velocity adjustments.
numericalChanges: No force, integrator, physical mass, epsilon or dt changed. New diagnostics read states only.
